subject: mathematics
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student scales a physical shape up and down from a center point using a scale factor
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a dilated figure to its correct scale factor relative to the original
exercise.abstract: Student finds the coordinates of a figure after a described dilation and identifies similar figures

misconception_flags: applies the scale factor by addition rather than multiplication to the coordinates

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
